text: FABLE REVIEW SCHEDULED (risk 6 of 6). Why risky: the whole slice is ONE behaviour -- change a value in timebase-repair.json and the suite goes red -- and it is easy to write a test that looks right and does not bite. The existing suite is precisely that failure: SherlockAnnotationsSuite.scala:188-199 is NAMED for the JSON and asserts Scala literals against Scala literals. Review must attack: does the new test compare PARSED against USED, and does mutating the JSON actually turn it red?
